dcterms:description: A large bilingual corpus used for training the Chinese→English translation task, consisting of 6.7M sentence pairs from the CWMT Corpus and 9M sentence pairs from the UN Parallel Corpus.
dcterms:title: Bilingual Training Data for Chinese→English Translation

dcterms:description: A large bilingual corpus used for training the English→Chinese translation task, consisting of 6.7M sentence pairs from the CWMT Corpus, 3.5M sentence pairs from the UN Parallel Corpus, and 0.6M sentence pairs from the Wiki Titles Corpus.
dcterms:title: Bilingual Training Data for English→Chinese Translation

dcterms:description: A large monolingual corpus used for back-translation, including English Gigaword, English News Crawl, and the English part of CWMT and UN corpus.
dcterms:title: Monolingual Data for Back-Translation
